title: authentication.update
description: Update existing authentication settings. Only available to Super admin user type. There is a single, singleton Authentication object (no ID field); pass any subset of its properties to update.

authentication_type.description: Default authentication method. Possible values: 0 - (default) Internal; 1 - LDAP.

http_auth_enabled.description: HTTP authentication. Possible values: 0 - (default) Disabled; 1 - Enabled. Supported if $ALLOW_HTTP_AUTH is enabled in the frontend configuration file (zabbix.conf.php).

http_login_form.description: Default login form. Possible values: 0 - (default) Zabbix login form; 1 - HTTP login form. Supported if $ALLOW_HTTP_AUTH is enabled in the frontend configuration file (zabbix.conf.php).

http_strip_domains.description: Domain name to remove. Supported if $ALLOW_HTTP_AUTH is enabled in the frontend configuration file (zabbix.conf.php).

http_case_sensitive.description: HTTP case-sensitive login. Possible values: 0 - Off; 1 - (default) On. Supported if $ALLOW_HTTP_AUTH is enabled in the frontend configuration file (zabbix.conf.php).

ldap_auth_enabled.description: LDAP authentication. Possible values: 0 - (default) Disabled; 1 - Enabled.

ldap_case_sensitive.description: LDAP case-sensitive login. Possible values: 0 - Off; 1 - (default) On.

ldap_userdirectoryid.description: ID of the default user directory for LDAP authentication. Used for user groups with gui_access set to LDAP or System default. Required if ldap_auth_enabled is set to "Enabled".

saml_auth_enabled.description: SAML authentication. Possible values: 0 - (default) Disabled; 1 - Enabled.

saml_case_sensitive.description: SAML case-sensitive login. Possible values: 0 - Off; 1 - (default) On.

passwd_min_length.description: Password minimal length requirement. Possible values range from 1 to 70. Default: 8.

passwd_check_rules.description: Password checking rules. This is a bitmask field; any sum of possible bitmap values is acceptable (for example, 15 for checking all rules). Possible bitmap values: 0 - Check password length; 1 - Check if password uses uppercase and lowercase Latin letters; 2 - Check if password uses digits; 4 - Check if password uses special characters; 8 - (default) Check if password is not in the list of commonly used passwords and does not contain derivations of word "Zabbix" or user's name, last name, or username.

ldap_jit_status.description: Status of LDAP provisioning. Possible values: 0 - Disabled for configured LDAP IdPs; 1 - Enabled for configured LDAP IdPs.

saml_jit_status.description: Status of SAML provisioning. Possible values: 0 - Disabled for configured SAML IdPs; 1 - Enabled for configured SAML IdPs.

jit_provision_interval.description: Time interval between JIT provision requests for logged-in user. Accepts seconds and time unit with suffix with month and year support (3600s, 60m, 1h, 1d, 1M, 1y). Minimum value: 1h. Default: 1h. Available only for LDAP provisioning.

disabled_usrgrpid.description: ID of the user group to assign the deprovisioned user to. The user group must be disabled and cannot be enabled or deleted when configured. Required if ldap_jit_status is set to "Enabled for configured LDAP IdPs", or saml_jit_status is set to "Enabled for configured SAML IdPs".

mfa_status.description: Multi-factor authentication. Possible values: 0 - Disabled (for all configured MFA methods); 1 - Enabled (for all configured MFA methods).

mfaid.description: Default MFA method for user groups with MFA enabled. Required if mfa_status is set to "Enabled".
